en-US.description: Windows-native AI voice dictation. Hold Ctrl+Space, speak, release - cleaned-up text is typed into any Windows app in under a second.
en-US.longDescription:
Pithflow is a Windows-native voice dictation app built in Rust - a ~5 MB installer, not an Electron wrapper. Hold Ctrl+Space, speak, release: your words come back as cleaned-up text, typed straight into whatever app has focus. Sub-second round trip.

Privacy-first by design: your session is DPAPI-encrypted on your machine and audio is never stored. Transcription runs in the cloud, so an internet connection is required.

Because Pithflow types like a keyboard, it works where most dictation tools fail - including RDP, Citrix, and VDI sessions.

Native bilingual Spanish/English, including mid-sentence Spanglish code-switching. Handles 100+ other languages too.

Free tier: 2,000 words per week, no card required. Pro is $9.99/month or $99/year. Windows 10/11.
en-US.name: Pithflow
